_comment: NEEDS_NEW_DSL: 'While this is DEFENDING, cards with {p} greater than the attack they are defending get +1{d}' is a continuous effect scoped to the defending step, granting +{d} to OTHER defending cards chosen by a comparison against the attack's power. No effect grants defence to co-defenders, and no condition compares a defender's power to the attack. ability_type corrected to TRIGGERED/ON_DEFEND so it is at least reachable; the effect body is still wrong.
